**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject calendar years after an implicit RMB unit**

When a named currency precedes a wage period, this boundary check allows the token to stop before `年`; consequently `normalizeMoneyValueV4('币种：人民币 2026年1月工资')` returns `exact` with `2026.00`, and `classifyMonetaryExpression` treats this amount-free table label as monetary. Reject a four-digit token followed by a calendar continuation before appending the omitted yuan unit, so a year cannot become an exact wage amount.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Detect attached halving operations**

The operation predicate covers explicit fractions, discounts, and doubling but misses the common complete suffixes `减半`/`減半` and `折半`. As a result, `normalizeMoneyValueV4('4000元减半')` and `normalizeMoneyValueV4('4000元折半')` both expose the operand as exact `4000.00`, and the scorer canonicalizes it as that amount rather than an arithmetic expression. Treat these bounded suffixes as operations so the base value cannot be mistaken for the result.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept explicit wage receipts recorded as 到账**

Beyond the newly supported `支付`/`发放` layouts, a direct receipt such as `王甲工资于2026年1月15日到账` still fails attribution because this receipt branch recognizes only `收到` and `领取`. Runtime review therefore adds `source_relation_unresolved` to a valid `payment_date`; include bounded `到账`/`入账` receipt wording while retaining the existing owner and full-envelope checks.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat explicit plural owner labels as collective**

Explicitly plural subjects outside this finite vocabulary, such as `王氏兄弟` and `双方`, are treated as individual owners. I verified that `王氏兄弟2026年1月全部应付工资合计4000元` with `scope: "individual"` receives no review issue, and after scope review `buildFactView` exposes `4000.00` as the individual due-field candidate. Reject kinship and other explicit plural labels as collective so a group total cannot become one worker's suggested amount.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat postposed limit phrases as bounds**

When a limit follows the amount through a copula, this suffix check misses it: `normalizeMoneyValueV4('4000元为上限')`, `...为下限`, and `以4000元为上限` all return `exact` with `4000.00`. These phrases specify a ceiling or floor rather than a confirmed amount, so allow the bounded `为/作为 + 上限/下限` layout before exposing the value as exact.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept the classifier in hourly rate units**

Hourly rates written as `4000元每个小时`, `4000元/个小时`, or their traditional equivalents are classified as unsupported because the optional `个/個` applies only to `月`. These are ordinary spellings of the already-supported `hour` rate unit, so a correctly declared `meaning: "rate"` candidate currently loses its amount solely because of the classifier.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept yearless month/day payment dates**

When the source states an explicit payment event without a year, such as `王甲工资于1月15日支付`, the candidate value `1月15日` receives `source_relation_unresolved` because this point-date branch accepts only `calendarDate`, even though `shortDate` already represents this source-preserving form. Accept a bounded month/day point date in the same owner, wage, and payment-verb envelope rather than requiring the model to invent a year.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept 与 in parallel wage periods**

Parallel wage periods joined with `与` or `與`, such as `王甲2026年1月与2月工资所属期间`, fail attribution while the equivalent `和` and `及` forms pass. The date detection view already folds `與` to `与`, but this complete-list grammar excludes that conjunction, so a valid full `wage_period` candidate is marked `source_relation_unresolved`; include the bounded conjunction alongside the existing separators.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recognize 应发 and 实发 complete totals**

Common payroll totals such as `王甲2026年1月应发工资合计4000元` and `王甲2026年1月实发工资合计3500元` fail this relationship gate: the due branch requires `应付`, while the paid branch recognizes `实付` but not `实发`. These terms are already treated as due/paid totals by the repository's extraction vocabulary, so an otherwise explicit individual complete total receives `source_relation_unresolved` and cannot populate the corresponding suggestion.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
